observation_summary: The Week constructor was incorrectly initializing its internal state by using a default time zone instead of the provided time zone argument.
reasoning_summary: The fix involved changing a hardcoded constant/default value (RegularTimePeriod.DEFAULT_TIME_ZONE) to the correct parameter (zone) passed into the constructor. This is a classic case of incorrect initialization of an object's state.
evidence_used: The fix_diff_oracle shows the change from 'this(time, RegularTimePeriod.DEFAULT_TIME_ZONE, Locale.getDefault());' to 'this(time, zone, Locale.getDefault());'.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the constructor signature is an interface, the error is not a mismatch in the contract itself, but rather an internal implementation error where the wrong value was used to initialize the object.
